has release

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasRelease
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRelease
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

Relates a project to one of its releases. Non-functional: a project has many releases over time.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Project -> gmeow:Release

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasRelease from gmeow:Project to gmeow:Release when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Project, gmeow:Release
